integrity: The rank and nilpotency formulas are proved from the complete six-parameter derivation matrix and finite-field rank counts. Exhaustive checks over prime fields and a direct implementation of the non-prime field of order four are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra. Higher Heisenberg ranks impose conformal-symplectic constraints and are not covered. The 2011 structural predecessor was accessible through publisher metadata and abstract but not full text; a later full-text arbitrary-field paper was inspected for the exact ordinary derivation matrix.
title: Rank and nilpotency spectra of derivations of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
